decision_record.transfer: Tensor 1W confluence edge is paid by dip-buyers on a QQQ-down day within 5 sessions of the signal; capture requires entering at the current price in the designed $1,000 slot with a true 15% stop.
decision_record.comparison: Signal-time fire price (up to 5 sessions stale) vs latest bar close for price-sensitive filters, sizing and stop, on identical fires/bars.
decision_record.mechanism: Execution/risk: the market entry fills at the current price, but pre-change qty/stop/filters used the stale fire price — fills oversized past the slice and the stop sat far below the designed 15% under the fill.
decision_record.calculation: Fixture fire $10, current $20: control qty=100 stop=8.5 (fill cost $2000, stop 57.5% below fill); treatment qty=50 stop=17.0 (fill cost $1000, stop 15% below fill). deep70 computed sleeves additionally refuse when the current price no longer satisfies deep70.
decision_record.experiment: Pre-registered A/B in tests/test_edge_batch22_blockers.py::TestExecPrice (treatment vs switch-OFF control on identical fixtures). Rejection rule: OFF divergence from pre-change, any treatment entry whose qty*current price exceeds the slot, or stop != 0.85*current — revert. Forward paired rows in extra.q07_exp_journal.

change: Filters (cheap5/deep70 price terms), share sizing and 15% stop revalidated at the latest bar close; fire price is fallback only when no bars exist
switch: extra.q07_enh[<sleeve>].exec_price default ON; OFF restores pre-change rule exactly
shadow_control: switch OFF on identical fixtures; live paired records in extra.q07_exp_journal
fail_first: 5 failures across batch-22 blockers on pre-change engines (stash-proven); 9/9 GREEN after
